widgets_values: 5岁小女孩，圆脸大眼睛，扎双马尾，穿黄色恐龙印花T恤和牛仔背带裤，脚踩红色小雨靴，背着一个小恐龙图案的儿童双肩包。

How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 10.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, photoreal with subtle CG creature detail, a vertical 9:16 high-angle wide shot begins exactly as Picture 1 with the girl's body curled in mid-air above a moss-covered prehistoric forest floor, her pink dinosaur backpack on her back. The camera tracks down with large amplitude at fast speed, holding her centered as she falls between drifting haze and thin shafts of daylight, giant ferns and towering conifers rising around her. She hits the thick moss with a soft bounce, leaves a shallow dent, and moss flakes drift down around her. The camera slows and pushes in with small amplitude as she braces on her hands, sits back on the moss, and tilts her face up toward the light, her pigtails settling, matching the pose, framing, and lighting of Picture 2 at the end of the shot.

overall_soundscape: Wind rushes past the falling body before a muffled thud lands on soft moss. Loose moss and leaves patter down afterward, while insects and distant animal calls fill the humid forest air.

non_diegetic_music: A bright hand-drum and pizzicato-string adventure figure at a moderate tempo, easing in volume at the end.

How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 10.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, photoreal with subtle CG creature detail, a vertical 9:16 low-angle wide shot begins exactly as Picture 1 with three Triceratops, each about 2.5 meters tall and 10 meters long, lined up and lowering their heads on a distant clearing while the small backs of the girl and the dark green Tyrannosaurus fill the foreground. The camera holds with small amplitude as the herd breaks into a charge, dirt bursting under their columnar legs and giant ferns bowing at the sides; the lead animal's left brow horn shows a third old crack. The Tyrannosaurus steps forward, drops its shoulder, and plants itself between the herd and the girl, lowering its head toward the incoming horns. The lead Triceratops closes in until its horns fill the middle of the frame, matching the framing, position, and lighting of Picture 2 at the end of the shot.

overall_soundscape: Heavy footfalls pound in a fast rhythm as turf and grit spray sideways. Low bellowing breaths answer each step, and ferns hiss as they bend.

non_diegetic_music: A driving taiko drum pattern at a fast tempo with low strings stabbing on each beat.
